tasks.label: Infra: subir banco, redis, storage e mailpit
tasks.command: docker compose up -d db redis storage storage-init mailpit

tasks.label: API: subir (api, worker, scheduler)
tasks.command: docker compose up -d api worker scheduler

tasks.label: Xdebug: ligar
tasks.command: XDEBUG_MODE=debug docker compose up -d api worker scheduler

tasks.label: Xdebug: desligar
tasks.command: XDEBUG_MODE=off docker compose up -d api worker scheduler

tasks.label: Pint: formatar arquivo atual
args: docker compose exec -T api vendor/bin/pint "$(echo '${relativeFile}' | sed 's#^backend/##')"

tasks.label: Larastan: analisar
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T api vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --memory-limit=1G --no-progress

tasks.label: PHPUnit: todos
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T api php artisan test

tasks.label: PHPUnit: arquivo atual
args: docker compose exec -T api php artisan test "$(echo '${relativeFile}' | sed 's#^backend/##')"

tasks.label: PHPUnit: cobertura (gera clover para o editor)
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T api php vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover=storage/coverage/clover.xml

tasks.label: Composer: audit
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T api composer audit

tasks.label: Front: qualidade (lint, tipos, testes, build)
tasks.command: npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run test:unit -- --run && npm run build
